tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Page canvas behind panels. Maps to --background.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panels, cards, inputs, assistant bubbles. Maps to --surface.

tokens.name: subtle
tokens.usage: Recessed fills: table header, JSON blocks, hover on rows, tenant chips.

tokens.name: foreground
tokens.usage: Primary text on background, surface and subtle. Maps to --foreground.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text (meta, dates, hints) on background, surface and subtle. Maps to --muted.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and panel outlines (decorative, not the only cue). Maps to --border.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (inputs, selects, secondary buttons): 3:1 on surface and background.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Primary action fill, links, focus ring, tenant bubble. Maps to --accent.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover / pressed fill.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill (primary button, tenant bubble). Maps to --accent-text.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Selected row, active nav, quiet accent backgrounds; foreground text reads on it.

tokens.name: priority-emergency
tokens.usage: Emergency priority: badge text/icon on priority-emergency-soft, and the emergency ticket edge. Never decorative.

tokens.name: priority-emergency-soft
tokens.usage: Emergency badge background and emergency notice panel.

tokens.name: priority-high
tokens.usage: High priority: badge text/icon on priority-high-soft.

tokens.name: priority-high-soft
tokens.usage: High priority badge background.

tokens.name: priority-normal
tokens.usage: Normal priority: badge text/icon on priority-normal-soft.

tokens.name: priority-normal-soft
tokens.usage: Normal priority badge background.

tokens.name: priority-low
tokens.usage: Low priority: badge text/icon on priority-low-soft.

tokens.name: priority-low-soft
tokens.usage: Low priority badge background.

tokens.name: status-ok
tokens.usage: Step/run OK, ticket resolved: text/icon on status-ok-soft, surface and background.

tokens.name: status-ok-soft
tokens.usage: OK badge background.

tokens.name: status-rejected
tokens.usage: Rejected — the system correctly said no (a guardrail held). Text/icon on status-rejected-soft; always paired with the shield icon and a dashed outline.

tokens.name: status-rejected-soft
tokens.usage: Rejected badge and rejected timeline card background.

tokens.name: status-error
tokens.usage: Error — something broke. Text/icon on status-error-soft; always paired with the filled alert icon and a solid outline.

tokens.name: status-error-soft
tokens.usage: Error badge and error timeline card background.

tokens.name: review
tokens.usage: Human review: badge text/icon on review-soft and the review marker on tickets.

tokens.name: review-soft
tokens.usage: Human review badge background.

families.sans: "Geist", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
families.mono: "Geist Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: title-lg
styles.usage: Screen titles (portal header, inspector run title).

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Ticket titles, timeline event names, table group headers.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: I've logged this as an emergency.
styles.usage: Tenant chat bubbles and tenant-facing notices. Never smaller than this for tenant messages.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default UI text, ticket descriptions, form labels.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Meta lines, hints, inspector table cells.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Badges, column headers, pipeline stage labels.

styles.name: mono-sm
styles.usage: Numeric cells: tokens, duration, cost. Use tabular figures.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, badge vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Badge horizontal padding, gaps in meta rows.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Control padding (x), bubble padding (y), table cell padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card and bubble padding, gap between stacked fields.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Panel padding on mobile.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Panel padding on desktop, gap between panels.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section separation, empty-state padding.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Page gutters on wide screens.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, JSON blocks, pipeline chips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Panels, ticket cards, timeline cards.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Chat bubbles (with one 4px corner toward the speaker).

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Status dots, avatars, spinner.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Panels on background. The only resting shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Floating layers only: select menus, toasts.

tokens.name: border-hairline
tokens.usage: All dividers and control borders.

tokens.name: border-focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring width (offset 2px).

tokens.name: border-edge
tokens.usage: Emergency ticket top edge and selected timeline event rail.
